database_migration_summary: M1.1 created the Django framework foundation with only Django's built-in infrastructure apps; no BarClimb business models or application migrations exist.
latest_test_summary: M1.2 passes on Python 3.13.15/Django 5.2.17/Celery 5.6.3: clean hash-locked install; Ruff/system checks; 9 deterministic tests on SQLite and PostgreSQL 14 with real Redis 7.2 readiness; live Celery worker discovery and smoke-task execution with results disabled; existing npm check/portability and continuity validation. CI now targets PostgreSQL 17 plus Redis 7.2 and performs the worker smoke. Heroku deployment/managed-provider verification and native simulator/device/store builds remain unverified.
high_risk_items: Execution breadth across web, iOS, Android, AI assessment quality, community moderation, and cross-platform commerce.

Milestone 2 must prove automated official-scope and Rule Obligation completeness with primary/official authority and lawful multi-source reconciliation; Sourcebooks are optional enhanced reconciliation, not a launch dependency.
Cross-scenario projections, anonymous claim security, private public-page overlays, entitlement transitions, and cross-device orchestration require explicit integration/security tests before GA.
Official NCBE scope/source changes must pass source-drift and revalidation workflow; future exam scopes remain provisional until governing materials exist.
exact_next_task: Execute a bounded M1.3 identity and authentication foundation slice: email + username + password accounts, verification/reset contracts, secure browser session/CSRF and native credential-storage architecture, without beginning curriculum, assessments, billing, or other later product domains.
